title: Rational quivers: Lean 4 formalization of Rational structures on quivers and a generalization of Gelfand's equivalence
description:
Lean 4 and mathlib formalization, together with the LaTeX source, of the manuscript Rational structures on quivers and a generalization of Gelfand's equivalence. For every field E of characteristic 0 and every l ≥ 0, the functor E_E is an equivalence of abelian categories between the E-rational Harish-Chandra modules HC_λ(sl_2, SO(2))_E, λ = l2, and the nilpotent representations of the E-rational Gelfand quiver (Theorem B; Theorem A is the case E = Q), together with the twisted forms.

The formalization was carried out with the assistance of AI agents (Claude Code and Anthropic's Claude models) under the author's direction. The author reviewed the results and takes full responsibility for the content.
